products.title: DEMCO Series DM 7500 Gate Valve, 2″ Seat Port, 7,500 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco dm 7500 gate valve 2 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve is a slab-gate mud valve with a 2 in (50 mm) seat port, rated 7,500 psi working pressure. Weld, flanged and hammer-union bodies are listed in test Groups 1 to 3, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve 2 inch is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat for drilling-mud service. It has a 2 in seat port (50 mm) and a 7,500 psi working pressure, and it is hydrotested to API Spec 6A testing requirements. It is not API monogrammed.

How it is built

Two identical metal wear rings are encapsulated in elastomer to form a cylinder with a gate slot and two ports. The closed gate bears on the downstream wear ring, and the elastomer gives a drop-tight, pressure-responsive seal. The body is ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class D with a 4130 bonnet, and the valve is NACE MR0175 compliant. It takes 8.6 handwheel turns from open to closed, and the open height from centre to top is 13.04 in (331 mm).

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Flanged: 10,000 psi RTJ flange, ring BX-152, flange OD 7.88 in (200 mm), 8 × 3/4 in bolts.
  • Weld: 2.00 in XXH or 3.00 in OD × 2.00 in ID.
  • Hammer union: 2 in XXH Fig 1502 hammer union.

Lengths and weights: weld ends 9.00 in (229 mm) and 38 kg; flanged 20.50 in (521 mm) and 65 kg; 2 in hammer union 15.74 in (400 mm) and 46 kg. The size table lists 12 part numbers across the three test groups. The neighbouring size is the DEMCO DM 7500 3 in gate valve.

Testing and standards

Group 1 is the basic build, with a shell test at 11,250 psi for 3 minutes and a seat test at 7,500 psi for 3 minutes on each side. Group 2 adds charted tests, a low-pressure seat test at 300 psi, impact tests at or below −50 °F (−46 °C) and surface NDE. Group 3 adds volumetric NDE on the body and bonnet. The assembly base numbers are J025088 (Group 1), J025103 (Group 2) and J025104 (Group 3).

How to order

Send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Trim options are a 410 SS stem, gate and wear rings in 41XX QPQ nitrided or 410 SS, and HNBR or FKM seals. The major repair kit is J025177-10274 and the minor kit is J025177-00274. DM 7500 parts never interchange with DM 5000 parts.

faqs.question: What size and pressure rating does the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve have?

Flanged ends are 10,000 psi RTJ with ring BX-152, flange OD 7.88 in (200 mm) and 8 × 3/4 in bolts. The valve is hydrotested to API Spec 6A testing requirements and is not API monogrammed.

faqs.question: How long and how heavy is the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: For the 2 in seat port, weld ends 9.00 in (229 mm) and 38 kg; flanged 20.50 in (521 mm) and 65 kg; 2 in hammer union 15.74 in (400 mm) and 46 kg. Open height from centre to top is 13.04 in (331 mm) and the handwheel is 14.00 in (356 mm) across, so allow that clearance on the manifold.

faqs.question: What materials and trim does the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve use?
faqs.answer: The body is ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class D and the bonnet is 4130. The stem is 410 SS (J024983-107), the gate is 41XX QPQ nitrided (2171111-01) or 410 SS QPQ nitrided (2139624-02), and the seat rings are 410 SS. Wear rings are M452267 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139647-02 (410 SS).

faqs.question: Should I specify HNBR or FKM seats on the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: Both are listed. The 2 in seat assembly is 2139742-01 with HNBR or 2139741-02 with FKM, and the part-number elastomer digit is 4 for HNBR or 2 for FKM. The gate catalogue rates HNBR −20 to 250 °F (−29 to 121 °C), formulated for synthetic and oil-based mud; FKM −10 to 400 °F (−23 to 204 °C), not for steam. Send the mud type and operating temperature with the enquiry.

faqs.question: How do I read the part number of the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: The part number starts with the assembly base (J025088, J025103 or J025104 for Groups 1, 2 and 3). Then add the end-connection and body digits (5 weld, 7 flanged, 9 hammer union), stem 7 for 410 SS, gate 2 for 41XX or 7 for 410 SS, seat ring 1, elastomer 4 for HNBR or 2 for FKM, and an inlay digit. J025088-3772140 is the catalogue example for a 2 in Group 1 flanged valve.

faqs.question: Which repair kits fit the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: The major kit is J025177-10274 and the minor kit is J025177-00274, both listed for the 410 SS stem, 41XX QPQ gate, HNBR seat and seals trim. The catalogue lists the major kit as one each for one year of service. See our [DEMCO gate valve repair kits](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits) range, and note these kits do not fit DM 5000 valves.

faqs.question: Which spare parts are listed for the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: Seats, stem seals, the screw and O-rings are listed. The parts list gives seat assemblies 2139742-01 (HNBR) and 2139741-02 (FKM), stem seal assemblies JN23231-008 (HNBR) and JN23231-006 (FKM), stem screw J001913, and O-rings AS-568-210 secondary seal, AS-568-224 housing seal, AS-568-229 wear ring seals and AS-568-342 bonnet seal. Also listed are housing J024982 and gate clip M450480.

faqs.question: What do Group 1, 2 and 3 mean on the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: Group 1 is the basic build with an 11,250 psi shell test for 3 minutes and a 7,500 psi seat test on each side. Group 2 adds charted 15-minute holds, a 300 psi low-pressure seat test, impact tests at or below −50 °F (−46 °C) and surface NDE. Group 3 adds volumetric NDE. For 2 in, the bases are J025088, J025103 and J025104.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in and the DM 5000 gate valve?
faqs.answer: The DM 7500 uses a ring seat insert with two wear rings sealed by O-rings, while the [DM 5000 2 in valve](/p/demco-dm-5000-gate-valve-2-inch) uses a one-piece seat assembly. The DM 7500 is the higher-pressure family, with a 10,000 psi RTJ flange on ring BX-152. Parts never interchange between the two, so match by series.

faqs.question: How do I operate and maintain the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: It closes in 8.6 handwheel turns, and the open height of 13.04 in (331 mm) sets the clearance needed above the line. The bonnet is held by 4 × 1-8 UNC × 4.50 in body studs and 2 × 3/4-10 UNC × 3.00 in studs. Replace seats, stem seal and O-rings together from a kit during overhaul, and keep wear rings with their own O-rings.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: Send the base number (J025088, J025103 or J025104), end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through [/contact](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Mention the test group and whether you need a repair kit, J025177-10274 for example, with the valve.

products.title: DEMCO Series DM 7500 Gate Valve, 5-1/8″ Seat Port, 7,500 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco dm 7500 gate valve 5-1/8 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DM 7500 5-1/8 in gate valve is a slab-gate mud valve with a 5-1/8 in (130 mm) seat port, rated 7,500 psi working pressure. Weld, flanged bodies are listed in test Groups 1 to 3, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve 5-1/8 inch is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat for drilling-mud service. It has a 5-1/8 in seat port (130 mm) and a 7,500 psi working pressure, and it is hydrotested to API Spec 6A testing requirements. It is not API monogrammed.

How it is built

Two identical metal wear rings are encapsulated in elastomer to form a cylinder with a gate slot and two ports. The closed gate bears on the downstream wear ring, and the elastomer gives a drop-tight, pressure-responsive seal. The body is ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class D with a 4130 bonnet, and the valve is NACE MR0175 compliant. It takes 27.8 handwheel turns from open to closed, and the open height from centre to top is 31.87 in (809 mm).

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Flanged: 10,000 psi RTJ flange, ring BX-169, flange OD 14.06 in (357 mm), 12 × 1-1/8 in bolts.
  • Weld: 6.00 in XXH or 7.25 in OD × 5.12 in ID.
  • Hammer union: not offered at this size.

Lengths and weights: weld ends 17.88 in (454 mm) and 241 kg; flanged 29.00 in (737 mm) and 350 kg. The size table lists 9 part numbers across the three test groups. The neighbouring size is the DEMCO DM 7500 4 in gate valve.

Testing and standards

Group 1 is the basic build, with a shell test at 11,250 psi for 3 minutes and a seat test at 7,500 psi for 3 minutes on each side. Group 2 adds charted tests, a low-pressure seat test at 300 psi, impact tests at or below −50 °F (−46 °C) and surface NDE. Group 3 adds volumetric NDE on the body and bonnet. The assembly base numbers are J025090 (Group 1), J025109 (Group 2) and J025110 (Group 3).

How to order

Send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Trim options are a 410 SS stem, gate and wear rings in 41XX QPQ nitrided or 410 SS, and HNBR or FKM seals. The major repair kit is J025177-10574 and the minor kit is J025177-00574. DM 7500 parts never interchange with DM 5000 parts.

products.focusKeyword: demco dm 5000 gate valve 2 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DM 5000 2 in gate valve is a slab-gate mud valve with a 2 in (50 mm) seat port, rated 5,000 psi working pressure. Flanged, weld, threaded and hammer-union bodies are listed, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM 5000 gate valve 2 inch is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat for drilling-mud service. It has a 2 in seat port (50 mm) and a 5,000 psi working pressure, and it is NACE MR0175 compliant. It is not API monogrammed.

How it is built

The seat is a one-piece cylindrical assembly that fits the machined body cavity. The bonnet and a spread ring in the bottom of the seat expand it outward against the ports when the bonnet is tightened onto the seat pin extensions of both wear rings. It seals even if the gate and seat ring are scored, and the single-piece seat is easy to replace. The valve closes in 10.2 turns, and the open height from centre to top is 13.00 in (330 mm).

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Flanged: ring R-24, flange OD 8.50 in (216 mm), 8 × 7/8 in bolts.
  • Ends listed: flanged 5,000 psi RTJ (R-24); weld Sch 80, XXH or Sch 160; threaded line pipe (LP) or external upset tubing (UPTBG); 2 in XXH Fig 1502 hammer union.
  • Lengths and weights: weld or threaded ends 9.00 in (229 mm) and 26 kg; flanged 12.12 in (308 mm) and 47 kg; 2 in hammer union 15.74 in (400 mm) and 35 kg.

The size table lists 10 part numbers, under the assembly bases J024929 (2 in nominal ends, threaded, flanged, weld and hammer union) and J025205 (2-1/2 in nominal weld ends). The neighbouring size is the DEMCO DM 5000 3 in gate valve.

Materials and trim

The body is ASTM A105 for threaded, weld and hammer-union valves and ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class A for flanged valves, and the bonnet is ASTM A105. The stem is 316 SS (J001931-008), the gate is 41XX electroless nickel plated (J001887-002) or stainless (J001887-108 (ASTM A351 CF8M)), and the seat insert is 1045 or stainless. Seals are Buna-N or FKM. The listed trim is 316 SS stem, 41XX ENP gate, 1045 Buna-N seat and seals.

Maintenance and spares

The major repair kit is J025216-11221 and the minor kit is J025216-01221, listed as one per year of service. DM 5000 (one-piece seat assembly) and DM 7500 (ring seat insert with wear rings) parts never interchange. To order, send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

products.title: DEMCO Series DM 5000 Gate Valve, 4″ Seat Port, 5,000 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco dm 5000 gate valve 4 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DM 5000 4 in gate valve is a slab-gate mud valve with a 4 in (100 mm) seat port, rated 5,000 psi working pressure. Flanged, weld, threaded and hammer-union bodies are listed, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM 5000 gate valve 4 inch is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat for drilling-mud service. It has a 4 in seat port (100 mm) and a 5,000 psi working pressure, and it is NACE MR0175 compliant. It is not API monogrammed.

How it is built

The seat is a one-piece cylindrical assembly that fits the machined body cavity. The bonnet and a spread ring in the bottom of the seat expand it outward against the ports when the bonnet is tightened onto the seat pin extensions of both wear rings. It seals even if the gate and seat ring are scored, and the single-piece seat is easy to replace. The valve closes in 22.9 turns, and the open height from centre to top is 24.57 in (624 mm).

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Flanged: ring R-39, flange OD 12.25 in (311 mm), 8 × 1-1/4 in bolts.
  • Ends listed: flanged 5,000 psi RTJ (R-39); weld Sch 80, XXH or Sch 160; threaded line pipe (LP) or TBS; 4 in or 5 in XXH Fig 1502 hammer union.
  • Lengths and weights: weld or threaded ends 13.00 in (330 mm) and 107 kg; flanged 18.00 in (457 mm) and 169 kg; 4 in hammer union 24.62 in (625 mm) and 149 kg; 5 in hammer union 22.62 in (574 mm) and 151 kg.

The size table lists 15 part numbers, under the assembly bases J025206 (4 in nominal ends), J025118 (5 in nominal weld and hammer union ends) and J025220 (6 in nominal weld ends). The neighbouring size is the DEMCO DM 5000 5-1/8 in gate valve.

Materials and trim

The body and bonnet are ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class D. The stem is 316 SS (J007439-008), the gate is 41XX electroless nickel plated (J001926-002) or stainless (J001926-108 (ASTM A351 CF8M)), and the seat insert is 1045 or stainless. Seals are Buna-N or FKM. The listed trim is 316 SS stem, 41XX ENP gate, 1045 Buna-N seat and seals.

Maintenance and spares

The major repair kit is J025216-14221 and the minor kit is J025216-04221, listed as one per year of service. DM 5000 (one-piece seat assembly) and DM 7500 (ring seat insert with wear rings) parts never interchange. To order, send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

products.title: DEMCO Series DM Gate Valve, ASME Class 600, 1-1/2″–6″
products.focusKeyword: demco dm gate valve class 600
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DM ASME Class 600 gate valve is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat, listed from 1-1/2 in to 6 in with flanged RF or RTJ, threaded, weld and grooved ends. The size table lists 40 part numbers, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM gate valve class 600 listing covers the DEMCO DM ASME Class 600 slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat in sizes 1.62 (1-1/2 in threaded ends), 2, 2-1/2, 3, 4, 6 and 6 (8 in flanges) in. Ends are RF or RTJ flanged, threaded, weld (Sch 40) and grooved (Sch 80). The size table lists 40 part numbers, each with its length and weight, so you can match the line before you enquire.

How it is built

A slab gate closes against an elastomer seat assembly, with a backup ring in chrome leather and bonnet and stem seals in Buna-N or FKM. The body and bonnet are ASTM A216 WCB, and the studs are ASTM A193 B7 with ASTM A194 2H nuts.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • For the 2 in size, the weld length is 8.88 in (226 mm), flanged RF is 11.50 in (292 mm) and RTJ is 11.62 in (295 mm). It weighs 12 kg weld and 20 kg flanged.
  • 2 in uses ring R-23 with a 6.50 in (165 mm) flange OD and 8 × 5/8 in bolts; 4 in uses R-37, 10.75 in (273 mm) and 8 × 7/8 in; 6 in uses R-45, 14.00 in (356 mm) and 12 × 1 in; the 8 in flange uses R-49 with 16.50 in (419 mm).

The 2 in size is 8.75 in (222 mm) high with an 11.00 in (279 mm) handle; the 6 in size is 19.25 in (489 mm) high with a 24.00 in (610 mm) handle. Assembly base numbers: flanged J001062, J001064, J001066, J001068, J001070 and J003945; weld J001092 to J001100; grooved J001082 to J001090; threaded J003938 and J001072 to J001080.

Materials and trim

The gate is 1045 ENP or ASTM A351 CF8M, the stem is 303 SS or 316 SS, and the seat insert is 1045 or ASTM A351 CF8M. The seat and seals are Buna-N or FKM.

Reading the part number

The number runs base, end connection, stem (2 = 303 SS, 8 = 316 SS), gate (2 = 1045, 8 = CF8M), seat insert (1 = 1045, 8 = CF8M), elastomer (1 = Buna-N, 2 = FKM) and inlay. Send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. See also the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve.

products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat, listed from 2 in to 6 in with flanged RF or RTJ, threaded, weld and grooved ends. The size table lists 40 part numbers, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM gate valve class 900 listing covers the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat in sizes 2, 2-1/2, 3, 4 and 6 in. Ends are RF or RTJ flanged, threaded, weld (Sch 40 or Sch 80) and grooved (Sch 80). The size table lists 40 part numbers, each with its length and weight, so you can match the line before you enquire.

How it is built

A slab gate closes against an elastomer seat assembly, with a backup ring in chrome leather and bonnet and stem seals in Buna-N or FKM. The body and bonnet are ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class A, and the studs are ASTM A193 B7 with ASTM A194 2H nuts.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • For the 2 in size, the weld length is 9.00 in (229 mm), flanged RF is 14.50 in (368 mm) and RTJ is 14.62 in (371 mm). It weighs 22 kg weld and 45 kg flanged.
  • 2 in uses ring R-24 with an 8.50 in (216 mm) flange OD and 8 × 7/8 in bolts; 3 in uses R-31, 9.50 in (241 mm) and 8 × 7/8 in; 4 in uses R-37, 11.50 in (292 mm) and 8 × 1-1/8 in; 6 in uses R-45, 15.00 in (381 mm) and 12 × 1-1/8 in.

The 3 in size is 12.75 in (324 mm) high with a 19.00 in (483 mm) handle; the 6 in size is 19.25 in (489 mm) high with a 24.00 in (610 mm) handle. Assembly base numbers: J003947 (2 in), J003951 (2-1/2 in), J003953 (3 in), J003955 (4 in) and J003999 (6 in).

Materials and trim

The gate is 1045 ENP or ASTM A351 CF8M, the stem is 303 SS or 316 SS, and the seat insert is 1045 or ASTM A351 CF8M. The seat and seals are Buna-N or FKM.

Reading the part number

The number runs base, end connection, stem (2 = 303 SS, 8 = 316 SS), gate (2 = 1045, 8 = CF8M), seat insert (1 = 1045, 8 = CF8M), elastomer (1 = Buna-N, 2 = FKM) and inlay. Send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. See also the DEMCO DM ASME Class 600 gate valve.

faqs.question: What sizes and pressure class does the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve cover?

Assembly bases are J003947 (2 in), J003951 (2-1/2 in), J003953 (3 in), J003955 (4 in) and J003999 (6 in).

faqs.question: How long and how heavy is the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve?

faqs.question: What materials and trim does the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve use?

faqs.question: Should I choose Buna-N or FKM for the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve?
faqs.answer: The ASME Class 900 valve takes Buna-N or FKM, selected by digit 1 or 2 in the part number. No service temperature is printed on this page for either, so send the fluid, concentration and operating temperature with the enquiry and we confirm the elastomer at quotation.

faqs.question: How do I read the part number of the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve?
faqs.answer: The part number starts with the base, such as J003947 for the 2 in valve. The end-connection digit follows: flanged 4 = Class 900 RTJ and 5 = Class 900 RF; weld 0 = Sch 40 and 1 = Sch 80; threaded 0 = line pipe (LP), 1 = tubing (TBG), 2 = external upset tubing (UPTBG); grooved 0 = Sch 80. Then come the stem, gate, seat insert, elastomer and inlay digits.

faqs.question: Which end connections does the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve offer?
faqs.answer: Ends are RF or RTJ flanged, threaded, weld (Sch 40 or Sch 80) and grooved (Sch 80). Threaded ends cover line pipe (LP), tubing (TBG) and external upset tubing (UPTBG). The size table lists 40 part numbers, one for each size, facing and end type.

faqs.question: Which spare parts and repair kits are available for the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve?
faqs.answer: The parts list covers the gate, stem, seat assembly, backup ring, bonnet and stem O-rings, studs and nuts. Recommended spares are marked in the parts list, and the specific part numbers are confirmed at quotation from your valve base, for example J003947. See also our [DEMCO gate valve repair kits](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits) range.

faqs.question: How does the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve compare with the neighbouring class?
faqs.answer: Class 900 sits between Class 600 and the [Class 1500 valve](/p/demco-dm-gate-valve-asme-class-1500), each with its own table. The 2 in Class 900 flanged RF length is 14.50 in (368 mm) at 45 kg with ring R-24, and the body is ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class A. Check this table before swapping a valve between classes.

faqs.question: How do I install and operate the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve?
faqs.answer: The 3 in size is 12.75 in (324 mm) high with a 19.00 in (483 mm) handle; the 6 in size is 19.25 in (489 mm) high with a 24.00 in (610 mm) handle. Allow that open height above the line, and remember the weights: 2 in 22 kg weld and 45 kg flanged; 2-1/2 in 39 kg and 77 kg; 3 in 43 kg and 73 kg; 4 in 64 kg and 104 kg. Keep the stem seals and O-rings from the same elastomer family when overhauling.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO DM ASME Class 900 gate valve?
faqs.answer: Use [/contact](/contact) with the base number (J003947 is the 2 in base), end connection, facing, stem and gate trim, elastomer and quantity. Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Quote the line class too, so the right of the 40 part numbers is picked.

products.title: DEMCO Series DMA 7500 Automated Gate Valve, Hydraulic Actuator, 2″–5-1/8″
products.focusKeyword: demco dma 7500 automated gate valve
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DMA 7500 is an automated gate valve for drilling mud at 7,500 psi working pressure, with a Ledeen double-acting hydraulic cylinder or a bare stem for actuation. Sizes 2, 3, 4 and 5-1/8 in seat ports, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DMA 7500 automated gate valve is a slab-gate valve for drilling-mud service, rated 7,500 psi working pressure and fitted with a Ledeen double-acting hydraulic cylinder, or supplied with a bare stem for your own actuation. Sizes are 2, 3, 4 and 5-1/8 in seat ports. The valve is NACE MR0175 compliant. Cylinder pressure is limited to 3,000 psi (20.7 MPa).

How it is built

The body is ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class D, the stem is 17-4PH SS and the gate is 17-4PH SS, QPQ nitrided. Seat and seal elastomer is HNBR or FKM. The parts list includes a Gar-Fil composite bushing, for example X-213635-01 at 2 in. Seat assemblies and wear rings carry the same numbers as the manual DM 7500 valve of the same size, for example 2139742-01 (HNBR) and 2139741-02 (FKM) at 2 in. Automation is offered on the 5,000 and 7,500 psi valves, selected by the actuation digit: 1 for the hydraulic Ledeen actuator, 2 for bare stem.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • 2 in: actuator LHL 70-60 DA, ports 4 × 3/8 NPT, open height 19.95 in (507 mm), ring BX-152.
  • 4 in: actuator LHL 100-110 DA, ports 4 × 1/2 NPT, open height 25.47 in (647 mm), ring BX-155.
  • Weights with actuator at 2 in: weld 49 kg, flanged 77 kg, 2 in hammer union 57 kg.

The size table lists 60 part numbers with weights that include the actuator. Lengths match the manual valve, for example 2 in: weld 9.00 in (229 mm), flanged 20.50 in (521 mm); 4 in: weld 16.00 in (406 mm), flanged 26.38 in (670 mm). The manual equivalent is the DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve.

Maintenance and spares

Only major repair kits are listed for DMA valves: J025177-10279 (2 in), J025177-10379 (3 in), J025177-10479 (4 in), J025177-10579 (5-1/8 in). They are listed for trim XX891401: 17-4PH stem, 17-4PH QPQ gate, HNBR seat and seals. Stem seal assemblies are separate numbers, X-213640-01 (HNBR) and X-213640-02 (FKM) at 2 in. Send the base number, size, end connection, test group, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

faqs.answer: The listed elastomer is HNBR or FKM, and the stem seal assemblies exist in HNBR and FKM, such as X-213640-01 (HNBR) and X-213640-02 (FKM) at 2 in. The gate catalogue rates HNBR −20 to 250 °F (−29 to 121 °C), formulated for synthetic and oil-based mud; FKM −10 to 400 °F (−23 to 204 °C), not for steam. faqs.answer: The assembly base depends on size and test group; at 2 in the bases are J025296, J025343 and J025344. The actuation digit is 1 for the hydraulic Ledeen actuator and 2 for bare stem. The repair kits are listed for trim XX891401.

faqs.question: Which repair kit fits the DEMCO DMA 7500 automated gate valve?
faqs.answer: Major kits only: 2 in J025177-10279, 3 in J025177-10379, 4 in J025177-10479, 5-1/8 in J025177-10579. Each is listed for trim XX891401: 17-4PH stem, 17-4PH QPQ gate, HNBR seat and seals. See our [DMA repair kits and parts](/p/demco-dma-automated-gate-valve-repair-kits-parts).

faqs.question: Which spare parts are listed for the DEMCO DMA 7500 gate valve?
faqs.answer: Listed parts include the gate, a Gar-Fil composite bushing, stem seal assemblies, and a gate clip on some sizes. At 2 in the gate is 2603688-01 and the bushing is X-213635-01; at 4 in the gate is X-213642-01. Seat assemblies and wear rings carry the same numbers as the manual DM 7500 valve of the same size, for example 2139742-01 (HNBR) and 2139741-02 (FKM) at 2 in.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the DEMCO DMA 7500 and the manual DM 7500 gate valve?
faqs.answer: The DMA adds a hydraulic cylinder (or a bare stem for actuation) and uses 17-4PH SS stems and gates, where the [manual DM 7500 valve](/p/demco-dm-7500-gate-valve-2-inch) is hand operated. Lengths match, but weights include the actuator, for example weld 49 kg at 2 in. Seat parts carry the manual valve numbers.

faqs.question: How do I install and plumb the DEMCO DMA 7500 hydraulic gate valve?
faqs.answer: Fit the valve with the actuator end clear: open height is 19.95 in (507 mm) at 2 in and 25.47 in (647 mm) at 4 in. Connect the cylinder ports (4 × 3/8 NPT at 2 in, 4 × 1/2 NPT at 4 in) and keep supply pressure below 3,000 psi (20.7 MPa). Bare-stem valves need your own actuator.

faqs.answer: Send the size, base number, end connection, test group, elastomer, actuation type (hydraulic or bare stem) and quantity through [/contact](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. At 2 in the major kit is J025177-10279.

On the DM 7500 the gate bears on the downstream wear ring of a ring seat insert. The gate slides between the seats and closes the 3 in port at 7,500 psi. Gate 2171112-01 is 41XX, QPQ nitrided; gate 2139628-02 is 410 SS, QPQ nitrided.

DM 5000 and DM 7500 parts never interchange. Match the 3 in gate to a DM 7500 valve before ordering; the base number on the valve settles it.

products.focusKeyword: demco dm 7500 gate valve body wear rings 2 inch–5-1/8 inch
products.descriptionShort: DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve body wear rings in 41XX QPQ nitrided or 410 SS for the 2 in, 3 in, 4 in and 5-1/8 in valves. Two rings per valve, each sealed by an AS-568 O-ring, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve body wear rings are the replacement wear rings for the 7,500 psi DM 7500 slab-gate valve in 2 in, 3 in, 4 in and 5-1/8 in seat ports. Each valve uses two wear rings, either 41XX with QPQ nitriding or 410 SS, and each ring is sealed by an AS-568 O-ring. The size table lists 8 part numbers, two per size.

How it is built

The DM 7500 uses a ring seat insert with wear rings, where the DM 5000 uses a one-piece seat assembly. That is why this page lists wear rings at all: the two families never interchange, and a DM 5000 has no wear ring to replace. The rings sit in the seat of the valve body and take the closing load of the gate, so they are among the first parts to show wear in service.

Sizes and part numbers

  • 2 in: M452267 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139647-02 (410 SS).
  • 3 in: M452571 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139648-02 (410 SS).
  • 4 in: M452290 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139649-02 (410 SS).
  • 5-1/8 in: M452619 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139650-02 (410 SS).

Materials and trim

The 41XX rings carry M45xxxx numbers and the 410 SS rings carry 21396xx-02 numbers. Each listed number is for the pair of rings in one valve. Choose the material that matches the trim already in the valve, and tell us if you are not sure so it can be confirmed at quotation. The wear ring O-rings are listed on the DEMCO DM gate valve O-rings and seals page.

How to order

Send the valve size, the base number or the number stamped on the old ring, the ring material and the quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. The seat insert for the same valve is on the DM 7500 seat insert page.

products.title: Demco DM Gate Valve Stem, 2″
products.focusKeyword: demco dm gate valve stem 2 inch
products.descriptionShort: DEMCO DM 2 in gate valve stems: J001931-008 in 316 SS for the DM 5000 and J024983-107 in 410 SS for the DM 7500, with the matching stem screw and stem seal assemblies, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM gate valve stem, 2 in, is the threaded shaft that lifts and lowers the gate in a 2 in DM mud gate valve. Two stems are listed for this seat port, one for the DM 5000 at 5,000 psi and one for the DM 7500 at 7,500 psi, and they belong to different valve families. The size table lists 8 part numbers, including the stem screw and the stem seal assemblies that go with each stem.

Which stem fits which valve

  • DM 5000: stem J001931-008 in 316 SS, with stem screw J001913 (CD 1213/15).
  • DM 7500: stem J024983-107 in 410 SS.
  • Older DM 2000–5000 valves: a stem stamped 1931-002 is listed as a stamped number.

Stem seals

The stem passes through a stem seal assembly with a bronze bushing. For the DM 5000 these are JN01949-001 (Buna-N and bronze) and JN01949-006 (FKM and bronze). For the DM 7500 they are JN23231-008 (HNBR and bronze) and JN23231-006 (FKM and bronze). The two sets are not the same, so the series decides the number.

Maintenance and spares

A stem is normally replaced together with its seal assembly, and the stem screw is checked at the same time. See the 2 in stem screw and stem packing listings. Stems for the larger seat ports are on separate pages. The DM 5000 has a one-piece seat assembly and the DM 7500 has a ring seat insert with wear rings, so parts of the two families never interchange.

How to order

Send the series, the valve base number or stamped stem number, the elastomer and the quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Give the series, seat port and elastomer on the order, and add the number stamped on the old part when you have it. This avoids a wrong match between the DM 5000 and DM 7500 families, whose parts never interchange.

faqs.answer: The DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw is the part the stem threads through in the bonnet, so the handwheel turn lifts or lowers the gate. The part number is J001913, in CD 1213/15, and the size table lists 3 part numbers for this size.

faqs.question: What are the part numbers of the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw?
faqs.answer: The 2 in stem screw is J001913 in CD 1213/15. Two stamped numbers, 1848 and 5530-224, also appear in the table as stem screw or bearing parts on DM valves. If your old part carries one of those, send the stamped number with the enquiry.

faqs.question: Which valves does the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw fit?
faqs.answer: J001913 is listed in the parts lists of both the 2 in DEMCO DM 5000 and the 2 in DM 7500. The stamped numbers 1848 and 5530-224 are listed against DM valves generally. Do not use the 2 in numbers on a larger seat port.

faqs.question: What material is the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw?
faqs.answer: The 2 in stem screw J001913 is CD 1213/15. The two stamped numbers, 1848 and 5530-224, are listed as stamped parts, so their material is confirmed at quotation from the number on the old part.

faqs.question: What pressure classes does the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw cover?
faqs.answer: The table lists J001913 against the 5,000 psi DM 5000, and the same number appears in the 2 in DM 7500 parts list at 7,500 psi. Tell us the valve series and class, and we confirm the match at quotation.

faqs.question: What should I replace with the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw?
faqs.answer: Check the stem and stem seal assembly at the same time. The [2 in stem](/p/demco-dm-gate-valve-stem-2-inch) page lists the DM 5000 and DM 7500 stems and seals that work with J001913, which is a single number shared by both 2 in valves.

faqs.question: When does the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw need replacing?
faqs.answer: Replace J001913 if its thread is stripped or worn, or if the handwheel feels rough or loose. It is normally checked whenever the 2 in stem is out, together with the stem seal assembly.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw part of a repair kit?
faqs.answer: J001913 is listed as a separate part. Repair kits for the 2 in valves are on the [gate valve repair kits](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits) range, and we confirm what each kit contains at quotation, so say whether you want the screw quoted with the kit.

faqs.question: What are the stamped numbers 1848 and 5530-224 on a DEMCO DM valve?
faqs.answer: The table lists 1848 and 5530-224 as stem screw or bearing parts, found as stamped numbers on DM valves at 2 in. If you have one, send it with the valve base number and we confirm the current replacement at quotation.

faqs.question: Does the DEMCO DM 2 in stem screw have a different number from the larger sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes. J001913 is the 2 in screw only. The 3 in and larger DM valves have their own screw numbers on their stem pages, such as the [DM 7500 stems](/p/demco-dm-7500-gate-valve-stems) page. The numbers are size specific.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO DM 2 in gate valve stem screw?
faqs.answer: Send the series (DM 5000 or DM 7500), the 2 in size, any stamped number from the old part and the quantity through [/contact](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Quote J001913 if you already know the number.

products.descriptionLong:
DEMCO DM gate valve O-rings and seals cover the AS-568 O-rings by position, secondary seal, housing seal, bonnet seal and, on the DM 7500, the wear ring seals. This listing is for the DM 5000 and DM 7500 at 2 in, 3 in, 4 in and 5-1/8 in, and the size table lists 40 part numbers in Buna-N, HNBR and FKM.

DM 5000 O-rings by size

  • 2 in: secondary AS-568-210 J005526-210; housing AS-568-224 J005526-224; bonnet AS-568-342 J005526-342 (Buna-N) or J005531-342 (FKM).
  • 3 in: AS-568-212 J005526-212; housing AS-568-226 J005526-226; bonnet AS-568-433 J005526-433 or J005531-433.
  • 4 in: AS-568-214 J005526-214; bonnet AS-568-439 J005520-439 or J005531-439.
  • 5-1/8 in: AS-568-216 J005526-216; housing AS-568-228 J005526-228; bonnet AS-568-367 J005520-367 or J005531-367.

DM 7500 O-rings by size

  • 2 in: AS-568-210 2712425-13 (HNBR) or J005531-210 (FKM); wear ring AS-568-229 2712425-03 or J005521-229; bonnet AS-568-342 2712425-60 or J005521-342.
  • 3 in: AS-568-214 2712425-01 or J005531-214; wear ring AS-568-340 2712783-03 or J005521-340; bonnet AS-568-361 2712787-07 or J005521-361.
  • 4 in: AS-568-216 2726268-01 or J005531-216; wear ring AS-568-349 2712787-04 or J005521-349; bonnet AS-568-364 2712426-11 or J005521-364.
  • 5-1/8 in: AS-568-218 2712425-12 or J005531-218; wear ring AS-568-435 2726268-02 or J005521-435; bonnet AS-568-446 2712425-78 or J005521-446; the housing seal is a urethane rod wiper 2726191-02-95.

How to order

Give the series, size, position and elastomer. DM 5000 and DM 7500 O-rings never interchange, so match the series first; wear rings are on the DM 7500 wear rings page. Send your list through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Give the series, seat port and elastomer on the order, and add the number stamped on the old part when you have it. This avoids a wrong match between the DM 5000 and DM 7500 families, whose parts never interchange.
products.seoTitle: DEMCO DM Gate Valve O-Rings & Seals, 2–5-1/8 in
products.seoDescription: DEMCO DM 5000 and DM 7500 gate valve O-rings and seals, 2 in to 5-1/8 in, Buna-N, HNBR, FKM. Table lists 40 part numbers. Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.

faqs.question: What are the DEMCO DM gate valve O-rings and seals for?
faqs.answer: They seal the secondary, housing, bonnet and wear ring positions of DEMCO DM 5000 and DM 7500 gate valves, in Buna-N, HNBR or FKM. Each is an AS-568 size, and the size table lists 40 part numbers across 2 in to 5-1/8 in.

faqs.question: Which O-rings fit the DEMCO DM 5000 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: The 2 in DM 5000 uses AS-568-210 secondary seal J005526-210, AS-568-224 housing seal J005526-224 and AS-568-342 bonnet seal in Buna-N (J005526-342) or FKM (J005531-342). Order by position as well as size.

faqs.question: Which O-rings fit the DEMCO DM 5000 3 in and 4 in gate valves?
Which O-rings fit the DEMCO DM 5000 5-1/8 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: The 5-1/8 in DM 5000 uses AS-568-216 secondary seal J005526-216, AS-568-228 housing seal J005526-228 and AS-568-367 bonnet seal in Buna-N (J005520-367) or FKM (J005531-367). Quote the position with each number.

faqs.question: Which O-rings fit the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in and 3 in gate valves?
Which O-rings fit the DEMCO DM 7500 4 in and 5-1/8 in gate valves?
What does the DEMCO DM 7500 5-1/8 in housing seal look like?
faqs.answer: At 5-1/8 in the DM 7500 housing seal is not an O-ring but a urethane rod wiper, part 2726191-02-95. The smaller DM 7500 sizes list Buna-N housing O-rings such as AS-568-224 (J005526-224) at 2 in and 3 in.

faqs.question: Should the DEMCO DM O-rings be Buna-N, HNBR or FKM?
faqs.answer: The DM 5000 lists Buna-N or FKM, such as J005526-342 or J005531-342 at 2 in. The DM 7500 lists HNBR or FKM, such as 2712425-60 or J005521-342. Match the seat elastomer. The gate catalogue rates HNBR −20 to 250 °F (−29 to 121 °C), formulated for synthetic and oil-based mud; Buna-N −10 to 200 °F (−23 to 93 °C) for petroleum oils, gases and fuel oils; FKM −10 to 400 °F (−23 to 204 °C), not for steam. Send the mud type and operating temperature with the enquiry.

faqs.question: Are DEMCO DM O-rings included in the repair kits?
faqs.answer: O-rings are listed here as separate parts, and a DM 7500 wear ring seal is needed twice per valve. Repair kits are on our [gate valve repair kits](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits) range. We confirm what each kit contains at quotation, so say whether you want extra O-rings.

faqs.question: Can I use DEMCO DM 5000 O-rings on a DM 7500 valve?
faqs.answer: No. Match by series and size even where a number such as J005526-224 appears in both lists. For example the 3 in DM 5000 uses AS-568-212 and 433, and the 3 in DM 7500 uses AS-568-214, 340 and 361. Parts never interchange between the two families.

faqs.question: When should the DEMCO DM O-rings be replaced?
faqs.answer: Replace them at every overhaul and whenever the bonnet or seat is disturbed, because a used O-ring may not reseal. A DM 7500 4 in overhaul, for example, needs the AS-568-216, AS-568-349 (two) and AS-568-364 O-rings.

faqs.question: How do I order DEMCO DM gate valve O-rings?
faqs.answer: Send the series, size, position (secondary, housing, bonnet or wear ring), elastomer and quantity through [/contact](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Quote part numbers such as J005526-224 if you already have them.
